functionalRequirement: System shall show the first lines of news articles based on the titles on the title screen.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Functional Completeness: The system must display the first 5 lines of each news article for 100% of the articles listed on the title screen.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR requires the system to show the first lines of news articles, ensuring that the content is fully displayed as intended.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Operability: The system must allow users to easily scroll through the list of news articles and view the first lines without additional clicks.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR implies a user-friendly interface where users can quickly access the first lines of news articles.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Time Behavior: The system must load and display the first lines of news articles within 2 seconds of the title screen being accessed.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves real-time display of news article snippets, which should be quick to enhance user experience.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Fault Tolerance: The system must handle and display a default message if the first lines of an article cannot be retrieved, without crashing or displaying errors.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR requires the system to display article snippets, and it should gracefully handle any issues that arise.

functionalRequirement: User shall be able to create a Gmail account by providing personal details like name, gender, password, mobile number, and location.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Functional Correctness: The system must validate all provided personal details (name, gender, password, mobile number, and location) according to specified rules (e.g., password strength, valid phone number format) with 100% accuracy.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR requires the system to create a Gmail account, which involves validating user input to ensure data integrity.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Confidentiality: The system must encrypt all personal details, including the password, using AES-256 encryption before storing them in the database.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves handling sensitive personal information, which must be protected to ensure user privacy.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Learnability: The system must provide clear instructions and feedback for each field, including password strength indicators and error messages for invalid inputs.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR requires users to input multiple details, and clear guidance will help users complete the process accurately.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Recoverability: The system must allow users to recover their account if they forget their password by sending a reset link to their mobile number or an alternative email address.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves account creation, and a recovery mechanism is essential for user convenience and security.

functionalRequirement: The system shall allow users to import and manage various data formats like images, videos, and audio files within presentations.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Functional Completeness: The system must support the import and management of images, videos, and audio files in common formats (e.g., JPEG, PNG, MP4, MP3) and provide options to edit, delete, and reorder these files within presentations.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR requires the system to handle multiple data formats, ensuring full functionality for user needs.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Resource Utilization: The system must use no more than 100 MB of memory to import and manage a single file, regardless of its format or size.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves handling various file types, and efficient resource management is crucial for performance.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: User Engagement: The system must provide a user-friendly interface with drag-and-drop functionality for importing and managing files, and clear visual feedback for file status (e.g., uploading, processing).
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR requires a user to interact with multiple file types, and a user-friendly interface will enhance the user experience.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Fault Tolerance: The system must handle file import errors gracefully, providing clear error messages and options to retry or cancel the import process.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves file management, and the system should be robust in handling potential issues.

functionalRequirement: User shall be able to set the price, quantity, upload pictures, and add details when listing an item.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Functional Correctness: The system must validate the price, quantity, and other details (e.g., item description, category) according to specified rules (e.g., price must be a positive number, quantity must be an integer) with 100% accuracy.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR requires the system to handle item listing, which involves validating user input to ensure data integrity.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Time Behavior: The system must save and display the listed item within 3 seconds after the user submits the form.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves a user action that should be quick to maintain a good user experience.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Operability: The system must provide a clear and intuitive form for listing items, with clear labels and input fields for price, quantity, and other details.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR requires users to input multiple details, and a clear form will help users complete the process accurately.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Integrity: The system must prevent unauthorized modification of listed items by ensuring that only the item owner can edit or delete the listing.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves user-generated content, and ensuring data integrity is crucial for trust and security.

functionalRequirement: Doctors shall be able to log in to check patient information, answer patient queries, perform daily activities, set reminders, and communicate with their staff.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Functional Completeness: The system must provide a comprehensive dashboard for doctors that includes all the required features (check patient information, answer queries, perform activities, set reminders, communicate with staff) and ensure that all features are fully functional.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR requires the system to support multiple tasks for doctors, ensuring that all features are available and functional.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Time Behavior: The system must load the doctor's dashboard and all its features within 2 seconds of logging in.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves a critical user role, and quick access to the dashboard is essential for efficient operation.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: User Engagement: The system must provide a user-friendly interface with clear navigation and intuitive controls for all features, including a searchable patient information database and a calendar for setting reminders.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves multiple tasks, and a user-friendly interface will enhance the doctor's experience and productivity.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Confidentiality: The system must encrypt all patient information and communication data using TLS 1.3 during transmission and store it using AES-256 encryption.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves handling sensitive patient information, which must be protected to ensure privacy and compliance with regulations.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Availability: The system must be available to doctors 99.9% of the time, with a maximum downtime of 15 minutes per month for maintenance or updates.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves critical operations, and high availability is essential for continuous patient care.
